hypotheses.justification: The conclusion does not mention ϖ or hϖ. The proof can choose a normalized uniformizer of the completion instead and use it in the intermediate lemmas. Such an element exists because the valuation on this number-field completion has value group ℤ, so an element of valuation −1 has norm (Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal : ℝ)⁻¹. This does not require any special case for zero or a trivial type: a height-one spectrum point gives a nontrivial discrete valuation.
